Lemma
[constant curvature: $R(\gamma ',J)\gamma '=K J$, coordinate form]

↗ lem:dc-ch5-2-3-const-form ↗ cor:dc-ch5-2-9

1. ch5:2.3On a manifold of constant sectional curvature $K_0$, if $J$ is normal to a unit-speed geodesic $\gamma $, then $R(\gamma ',J)\gamma '=K_0J$. Consequently the Jacobi equation is $D^2J/dt^2+K_0J=0$.
Proof

\sketch Pair $R(\gamma ',J)\gamma '$ with an arbitrary vector and apply equation 3; the unit-speed and orthogonality hypotheses leave $K_0\langle J,\cdot \rangle $.

□
